title: About our studio
seo_description: Woodex Interior is a design-led studio in Lahore shaping calm, material-led interiors around the people who live and work in them.
hero_intro: We see interiors as the backdrop to a life well lived. Personal, purposeful, and thoughtfully put together.

blocks.title:
Designing spaces.
Understanding people.
blocks.intro: We see interiors as the backdrop to a life well lived. Personal, purposeful, and thoughtfully put together.

blocks.title:
Beautiful design begins
with a better understanding.
blocks.alt: Light-filled studio interior with timber furniture and large windows
blocks.body:
Every space has its own possibilities. Every person brings a different way of living. At Woodex, we start by listening, then translate what we learn into interiors that feel coherent, comfortable, and quietly distinctive.

Our approach balances creative thinking with practical decisions. We care about how a room flows, how a material feels, and how a detail will serve you in everyday life — not just in a photograph.

items.title: People before trends
items.text: Your routines, preferences, and aspirations guide the design. We look beyond what is fashionable to find what feels right for you.

items.title: Honest by nature
items.text: We are drawn to authentic materials, warm textures, and a sense of restraint. Spaces should feel grounded, not overworked.

items.title: Considered in detail
items.text: The best interiors hold together at every scale. From the overall plan to the smallest junction, each decision has a purpose.

blocks.title:
Natural warmth.
Modern clarity.
blocks.alt: Natural timber beams, woven textures and warm neutral furnishings
blocks.body:
Wood is more than a material to us. Its grain, warmth, and individuality reflect the qualities we want every space to have.

Paired with tactile fabrics, quiet colors, and thoughtfully chosen stone and metal, it becomes part of an interior that feels balanced rather than overly coordinated.

items.q: Can you help with just one room?
items.a: Yes. We work with individual rooms as well as larger interior projects. A focused room scheme can include layout, colors, finishes, furniture, and styling.

items.q: How are design fees and timelines agreed?
items.a: They depend on the scope, size, and complexity of the project. A written proposal sets out the deliverables, design stages, fees, and schedule before work begins.

items.q: Do you design custom furniture and woodwork?
items.a: Yes. Bespoke design can include storage, cabinetry, wardrobes, and furniture concepts. Fabrication, installation, and specialist engineering are confirmed separately in the project proposal.

items.q: What should I prepare for an initial conversation?
items.a: A few photographs, available measurements or plans, an approximate budget, and a short list of priorities are a helpful place to start. Inspiration images are welcome too.

title: Privacy information
seo_description: How Woodex Interior collects, uses and stores the information you share through this website, and how to contact us about it.
hero_intro: How this website handles the information you share with us.

blocks.title: Privacy, simply put.
blocks.intro: How this website handles the information you share with us.

blocks.html:
Who we are

Woodex Interior is an interior design studio based in Lahore, Pakistan. You can reach us at woodexinterior.pk@gmail.com or +92 322 4000768.

What we collect

When you send an enquiry we store the name, email address, phone number, project location, service interest, timeline and message you choose to share. We also store the time of the request and a shortened technical record (IP address and browser) used to protect the form from abuse.

Why we use it

We use your details only to reply to your enquiry, to prepare a proposal, and to keep a record of the conversation. We do not sell your information and we do not use it for unrelated marketing.

Cookies and storage

The public website sets one short-lived cookie so that the enquiry form can be verified against cross-site request forgery. If you sign in to the studio content system, a session cookie keeps you signed in. No advertising or analytics cookies are set by default.

How long we keep it

Enquiries are kept while a project is active and for up to 24 months afterwards so that we can answer follow-up questions. You can ask us to delete your enquiry at any time.

Your choices

Write to woodexinterior.pk@gmail.com to ask for a copy of your information, to correct it, or to have it deleted. We will respond within 30 days.

Photography and sample projects

Portfolio projects on this site are design concepts illustrated with licensed stock photography. They are not presented as completed client commissions.

Last reviewed: 26 October 2026.

title: Master style guide
seo_description: The Woodex Interior design system: colour tokens, typography scale and interface components.

blocks.title:
The Woodex
visual language.
blocks.intro: A reference for the colour tokens, typography and components used across the website.

blocks.html:
Colour tokens

  • Ink #111111 — headings and primary copy
  • Body #525252 — supporting paragraphs
  • Navy #0f1e36 — dark feature bands
  • Accent #a87442 — focus rings and highlights
  • Soft #f5f5f3 — alternating section backgrounds
  • Beige #fcf2e8 — warm neutral panels

Typography

Headings use Nohemi at 400/500/600. Body copy uses Inter with a 16px base and 1.8 line height for long-form reading.

Components

Buttons are pill-shaped with a trailing arrow. Cards use a 1px rule, 8px radius and generous internal padding. Images sit inside rounded frames with a subtle zoom on hover.

Accessibility

Text meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, every interactive element has a visible focus ring, and all content images carry descriptive alt text.
